assets.prompt: Create one production-ready transparent sprite evolution sheet for an offline Chinese children's virtual pet game. Five equal-width columns in ONE horizontal row, on a 2560x768 canvas if possible, transparent alpha background. Each cell contains the SAME entire character centered with generous margins, feet on same baseline, no cell overlaps, no labels, no lettering, no ground, no boxes. Subject: a friendly cream-and-orange STAR CAT, cute kitten at stage 1, taller playful kitten stage 2, agile young cat with small glowing star collar stage 3, majestic star-marked guardian feline stage 4, magnificent luminous star guardian cat with silver-gold constellation markings and star halo stage 5. Visibly distinct evolution, coherent identity. High-end stylized 3D toy / polished animated film render, soft fur, amber eyes, exquisite materials, lavender rim light. All five full bodies face front three-quarter, tails visible, clean silhouette, isolated. This is a single game sprite-sheet asset, not a UI mockup.
